lead: Competitive intelligence signals across the rolling year highlight active EFB, flight planning, and crew system deployments alongside major corporate developments, notably Lufthansa Systems exploring a €1bn sale of its Lido and NetLine units. Vendor customer wins span low-cost, hybrid, and full-service carriers across multiple regions.

insights.title: IFS Secures Multiple LCC and Regional/Hybrid Wins for EFBOne
insights.finding: IFS captured notable customer wins for its EFBOne platform, including low-cost carrier fastjet and low-cost carrier MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air), alongside hybrid/leisure carrier TUS Airways.
insights.aviation_context: fastjet is classified as an African low-cost carrier (LCC), MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air) is an LCC, and TUS Airways is classified as a hybrid/leisure carrier.
insights.caveat: Captured announcement dates reflect feed visibility rather than immediate deployment completion.

insights.title: Strategic Corporate Restructuring in Flight Operations Software
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems has reportedly explored a sale of its core Lido and NetLine business units for approximately €1bn.
insights.aviation_context: Lido and NetLine provide critical flight planning, navigation, and network management software across global airlines.
insights.caveat: Reports indicate exploration of a sale, but no definitive transaction has been finalized in the captured data.

insights.title: Jeppesen and Aviobook Expand Airline EFB and Dispatch Footprint
insights.finding: Jeppesen secured major platform agreements including Korean Air for Jeppesen Dispatch and Corendon Airlines for ForeFlight EFFCore, while Aviobook signed Royal Air Maroc for its AvioBook Flight EFB.
insights.aviation_context: Korean Air and Royal Air Maroc operate as full-service network carriers.
insights.caveat: Captures represent announced agreements and launch partnerships.
